segments.en: Today I practise computer English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I say "client" when I talk about my computer project. I say "server" when I talk about my computer project. I say "API" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use client, server, and API. At the end, I say: I can use client clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“客户端、服务器与 API”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。client：客户端，主动向服务器请求服务的程序。示例：I learned how to use "client" in a computer task.server：服务器，接收请求并提供数据或功能的程序。示例：I learned how to use "server" in a computer task.API：应用程序接口，让不同程序按约定互相通信。示例：I learned how to use "A P I" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

I say "Could we see the menu?" in a daily conversation. I say "I'm allergic to peanuts." in a daily conversation. I tell my teammate: Today I use Do you have a table for two?, Could we see the menu?, and I'm allergic to peanuts.. At the end, I say: I can use Do you have a table for two? clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“日常交流英语”，场景是“餐厅沟通”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。Do you have a table for two?：有两个人的桌位吗？。示例：Do you have a table for two?Could we see the menu?：可以给我们看菜单吗？。示例：Could we see the menu?I'm allergic to peanuts.：我对花生过敏。。示例：I'm allergic to peanuts.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“日常交流英语”，场景是“餐厅沟通”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。Is this dish spicy?：这道菜辣吗？。示例：Is this dish spicy?Could you pack this to go?：可以把这个打包吗？。示例：Could you pack this to go?Everything was delicious.：所有菜都很好吃。。示例：Everything was delicious.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.en: Today I practise GitHub English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I use "draft pull request" when I work with my team. I use "mark as ready" when I work with my team. I use "convert to draft" when I work with my team. I tell my teammate: Today I use draft pull request, mark as ready, and convert to draft. At the end, I say: I can use draft pull request clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“草稿 PR”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。draft pull request：草稿拉取请求，尚未准备好合并的 PR。示例：Our team uses "draft pull request" to keep the project clear.mark as ready：标记为可评审，表示草稿已经准备完成。示例：Our team uses "mark as ready" to keep the project clear.convert to draft：转换为草稿，把正式 PR 退回准备状态。示例：Our team uses "convert to draft" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

hard.def: 草稿拉取请求，尚未准备好合并的 PR
标记为可评审，表示草稿已经准备完成
转换为草稿，把正式 PR 退回准备状态
